description: Platform super administrator with unrestricted access to all modules

Pension contributions officer – uploads and validates employer contributions

Pension compliance officer – regulatory compliance and audit

MFI loan officer – originates individual loans and meets clients
Group lending officer / village banking clerk – manages solidarity groups
Field officer / collection agent – client visits and repayment collection
Savings teller / cashier – processes deposits and withdrawals
Social performance officer – client protection, poverty assessments and outreach
